description: Which locked version of an event contract a producer emits by default (GX-37, D-070).

gate-contracts.gate_failed_version.description: Version of gate.failed emitted when the caller names none (the registry default). A newly locked version is not emitted until its producer moves and this entry changes (GX-09 sets 4); readers accept every locked version.

gate-contracts.gate_passed_version.description: Version of gate.passed emitted when the caller names none (the registry default). A newly locked version is not emitted until its producer moves and this entry changes (GX-09 sets 4); readers accept every locked version.
